```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

# Connect to database
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../assets/data/site_data.db")

# Define custom theme colors (fantasy/RPG palette)
theme_colors <- c("#0D2E2B", "#cfa600", "#793d03", "#4b7874", "#debb9d")
theme_colors_extended <- c("#0D2E2B", "#4b7874", "#6b9894", "#cfa600", "#e6bd00",
                           "#b89000", "#793d03", "#5A2800", "#a35004", "#debb9d", "#c9a788")

# Query employee data
employee_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM employees")

# Query usage data
usage_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM usage")

# Query leaderboard data
leaderboard_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT l.*, e.name, e.department
  FROM leaderboard l
  JOIN employees e ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
  ORDER BY l.rank
")

# Query server data
server_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM servers")

# Query software data
software_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM software")

# Query achievement counts
achievement_counts <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.name,
    e.department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT aq.task_name) as quantum_tasks,
    COUNT(DISTINCT as_.server_name) as server_actions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ac.repository) as code_contributions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ag.achievement_name) as general_achievements
  FROM employees e
  LEFT JOIN achievements_quantum aq ON e.employee_id = aq.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN achievements_server as_ ON e.employee_id = as_.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN achievements_code ac ON e.employee_id = ac.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN achievements_general ag ON e.employee_id = ag.employee_id
  GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.name, e.department
")

dbDisconnect(con)

# Prepare data for visualizations
dept_stats <- employee_data %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    total_employees = n(),
    avg_experience = mean(years_experience),
    total_projects = sum(projects_completed),
    avg_utilization = mean(utilization)
  )

usage_summary <- usage_data %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sessions = sum(total_sessions),
    avg_duration = mean(avg_session_duration),
    total_data = sum(data_processed_gb)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_sessions))

server_summary <- server_data %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("Low Load", "Normal", "High Load")))
```

## Overview

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Department Performance

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(dept_stats, aes(x = reorder(department, -total_projects), y = total_projects)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0D2E2B", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = total_projects), vjust = -0.5, color = "#5A2800", fontface = "bold") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#5A2800", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#5A2800"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Projects Completed by Department", x = "Department", y = "Total Projects")
```

### Usage Trends

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
usage_monthly <- usage_data %>%
  mutate(
    month_year = paste(month, year),
    month_order = case_when(
      month == "November" & year == 2025 ~ 1,
      month == "December" & year == 2025 ~ 2,
      month == "January" & year == 2026 ~ 3
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(month_year, month_order) %>%
  summarise(total_sessions = sum(total_sessions), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(month_order)

ggplot(usage_monthly, aes(x = reorder(month_year, month_order), y = total_sessions, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "#793d03", size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(color = "#cfa600", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#5A2800", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#5A2800"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Total Sessions Over Time", x = "Period", y = "Total Sessions")
```

### Server Status

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(server_summary, aes(x = status, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, color = "#5A2800", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low Load" = "#4b7874", "Normal" = "#0D2E2B", "High Load" = "#793d03")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#5A2800"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#5A2800", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#5A2800"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFF2db", color = NA)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Server Status Distribution", x = "Status", y = "Number of Servers")
```

## Detailed Data

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Employee Statistics

```{r}
employee_summary <- employee_data %>%
  mutate(
    avg_projects_per_year = round(projects_completed / years_experience, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Name = name,
    Department = department,
    Role = role,
    Experience = years_experience,
    Projects = projects_completed,
    Active = active_projects,
    Utilization = utilization,
    Status = status
  )

datatable(
  employee_summary,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    order = list(list(4, 'desc')),
    dom = 'rtip'
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'display'
) %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('High Load', 'Normal'),
                c('#fff3cd', '#d1ecf1')
              ))
```

### Leaderboard

```{r}
leaderboard_display <- leaderboard_data %>%
  select(
    Rank = rank,
    Name = name,
    Department = department,
    Points = total_points,
    Quality = quality_score,
    Innovation = innovation_score,
    Collaboration = collaboration_score,
    Rating = overall_rating,
    Badge = badge
  )

datatable(
  leaderboard_display,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    order = list(list(0, 'asc')),
    dom = 'rtip'
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'display'
)
```

### Usage by Department

```{r}
usage_dept_display <- usage_data %>%
  filter(year == 2026) %>%
  select(
    Department = department,
    Month = month,
    Sessions = total_sessions,
    `Avg Duration (min)` = avg_session_duration,
    `Data (GB)` = data_processed_gb,
    `Growth %` = growth_rate,
    Efficiency = efficiency
  )

datatable(
  usage_dept_display,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    order = list(list(2, 'desc')),
    dom = 'rtip'
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'display'
) %>%
  formatRound(c('Avg Duration (min)', 'Data (GB)', 'Efficiency'), 1) %>%
  formatRound('Growth %', 1)
```

### Software Catalog

```{r}
software_display <- software_data %>%
  select(
    Software = software_name,
    Category = category,
    Version = version,
    License = license,
    Users = users,
    `Adoption %` = adoption_rate,
    Status = status
  )

datatable(
  software_display,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    order = list(list(4, 'desc')),
    dom = 'rtip'
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'display'
) %>%
  formatRound('Adoption %', 1) %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('Recommended', 'Evaluation'),
                c('#d4edda', '#fff3cd')
              ))
```

### Achievements Summary

```{r}
achievement_display <- achievement_counts %>%
  mutate(
    total_achievements = quantum_tasks + server_actions + code_contributions + general_achievements
  ) %>%
  select(
    Name = name,
    Department = department,
    `Quantum Tasks` = quantum_tasks,
    `Server Actions` = server_actions,
    `Code Repos` = code_contributions,
    `General` = general_achievements,
    `Total` = total_achievements
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

datatable(
  achievement_display,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    order = list(list(6, 'desc')),
    dom = 'rtip'
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'display'
)
```
